## `GET /managed-targets`

Lists managed targets.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                           |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [ManagedTargetResource](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetresource) |

## `POST /managed-targets`

Store a vLLM template in a tuning namespace (the chart's rbac.tuning.namespaces).

**Request body:** [ManagedTargetCreate](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetcreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                  |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [ManagedTargetResource](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetresource) |

## `DELETE /managed-targets/{target_id}`

Tear down what servtuner deployed for it (the model cache stays), then forget it.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /managed-targets/{target_id}`

Returns one managed target.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                  |

## `PUT /managed-targets/{target_id}`

Replaces a managed target. Refused while an active session uses it.

| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [ManagedTargetCreate](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetcreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                  |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ManagedTargetResource](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetresource) |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror)     |

## `POST /managed-targets/{target_id}/boot-probe`

Poll the deployed configuration as a boot probe: its KV capacity, or why it did not boot (a tuningBootResult for servtuner propose). No result while it is still starting.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [BootProbeRequest](/reference/api/models/#bootproberequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [BootProbeView](/reference/api/models/#bootprobeview)             |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /managed-targets/{target_id}/check-launcher`

A host target's launcher: reached, token accepted, and what vLLM is doing there. Read-only, so it is allowed while a session tunes the target.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [LauncherCheckView](/reference/api/models/#launchercheckview)     |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `PUT /managed-targets/{target_id}/credentials/{slot}`

A host target's launcher\_token or api\_key: a pasted value servtuner keeps in a Secret it owns, or a Secret you name. Write-only: no route ever returns the value.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |
| `slot`      | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [CredentialInput](/reference/api/models/#credentialinput) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /managed-targets/{target_id}/deploy`

Apply the target with these vLLM knobs. Poll readiness before starting a run.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [DeployRequest](/reference/api/models/#deployrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                  |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `202`  | Successful Response | [ManagedTargetResource](/reference/api/models/#managedtargetresource) |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror)     |

## `GET /managed-targets/{target_id}/logs`

The end of vLLM's log: the newest pod's (a crash-looping one's last exit), or the host launcher's. Read-only, so it is allowed while a session tunes the target.

| Parameter    | In    | Type      | Required | Description                 |
| ------------ | ----- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `target_id`  | path  | `string`  | Yes      |                             |
| `tail_lines` | query | `integer` | No       | ≥ 1; ≤ 1000 Default: `200`. |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [LogView](/reference/api/models/#logview)                         |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /managed-targets/{target_id}/readiness`

One readiness poll: pending, ready, infeasible (a configuration result) or failed.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ReadinessView](/reference/api/models/#readinessview)             |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /managed-targets/{target_id}/scale-down`

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
